nodes.label: Next.js Bundled Docs Rule
nodes.rationale: This project's Next.js version has breaking changes; agents must read the bundled guides in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code and heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: Balangay of the Forgotten Website
nodes.rationale: Landing page and wiki for the 2D pixel game; must match the game's 2D pixel art aesthetic and stay compatible with future ASP.NET/Unity integration.

nodes.label: Balangay of the Forgotten (Game)
nodes.rationale: 2D pixel game built in Unity; the website is a portfolio for its characters and enemies, providing lore and game data to players.

nodes.label: Immersive Wiki
nodes.rationale: Core value: showcase the game's world and characters through an immersive wiki that will later integrate into a hybrid tabletop experience.

nodes.label: Hybrid Tabletop Experience
nodes.rationale: Future integration of the wiki into a hybrid tabletop experience via ASP.NET; a user requirement driving backend choices.

nodes.label: Next.js 15
nodes.rationale: Chosen over Blazor WASM for best-in-class SEO on wiki/landing pages; App Router supports React Server Components.

nodes.label: React 19
nodes.rationale: UI library; seamless integration with Next.js and modern pixel-art UI kits.

nodes.label: Payload CMS 3.0
nodes.rationale: TypeScript-native headless CMS that runs as a Next.js route handler (no separate server), perfect for lore/wiki data; chosen over MediaWiki which is legacy and harder to integrate with React apps.

nodes.label: ASP.NET Core 9.0
nodes.rationale: Game API/real-time backend; user requirement; shares C# with Unity for shared logic and models; Minimal APIs for high performance.

nodes.label: SignalR (Core 9.0)
nodes.rationale: Built-in support for hybrid tabletop real-time interactions.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL 16+
nodes.rationale: Primary data store; industry standard; easy to host on Supabase or Neon.

nodes.label: Unity 6 (LTS)
nodes.rationale: Game engine for the 2D pixel game; current stable version with modern .NET (CoreCLR) and WebGPU support.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS 4.x
nodes.rationale: Utility-first CSS, highly customizable for pixel-art aesthetic.

nodes.label: react-unity-webgl 9.x
nodes.rationale: For embedding and communicating with the Unity WebGL build.

nodes.label: Framer Motion 11.x
nodes.rationale: For frame-by-frame style animations and smooth page transitions.

nodes.label: Pixelact UI 1.x
nodes.rationale: Pre-styled pixel-art accessible components built on Radix/Tailwind; specific aesthetic choice.

nodes.label: GSD Workflow Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Before using file-changing tools, start work through a GSD command (gsd-quick, gsd-debug, gsd-execute-phase) so planning artifacts and execution context stay in sync; no direct edits outside GSD unless the user explicitly bypasses it.

nodes.label: Shared Models Library
nodes.rationale: Shared C# class library so Unity and ASP.NET Core reuse shared logic and models.

nodes.label: Blazor WASM (rejected alternative)
nodes.rationale: Rejected for frontend: Next.js has better SEO and faster initial load for landing pages/wikis.

nodes.label: Node.js Express (rejected alternative)
nodes.rationale: Rejected for backend: ASP.NET shares C# with Unity, allowing shared logic and models.

nodes.label: MediaWiki (rejected alternative)
nodes.rationale: Rejected for CMS: legacy and harder to customize/integrate with modern React apps.

nodes.label: Next.js Documentation
nodes.rationale: Cited as HIGH-confidence source for the Next.js 15 choice.

nodes.label: Payload CMS 3.0 Docs
nodes.rationale: Cited as HIGH-confidence source for the CMS choice.

nodes.label: ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs Docs
nodes.rationale: Cited as HIGH-confidence source for the game backend.

nodes.label: React Unity WebGL Documentation
nodes.rationale: Cited as MEDIUM-confidence source; community driven but standard.

nodes.label: Pixelact UI Site
nodes.rationale: Cited as LOW-confidence source; specific aesthetic choice.

nodes.label: balangay-of-the-forgotten-wiki Repository
nodes.rationale: Repo root README; names the repository balangay-of-the-forgotten-wiki.

nodes.label: Design System Master
nodes.rationale: Master design system for the Balangay of the Forgotten site; page-specific files override it.

nodes.label: Color Palette
nodes.rationale: Sky blue trust (primary #0EA5E9, secondary #38BDF8) + warm CTA accent (#F97316); background #F0F9FF, text #0C4A6E.

nodes.label: Retro Pixel Typography
nodes.rationale: Press Start 2P headings + VT323 body for a pixel, retro, gaming, 8-bit, nostalgic, arcade mood; loaded from Google Fonts.

nodes.label: Spacing Tokens
nodes.rationale: Scale from --space-xs (4px) to --space-3xl (64px) covering tight gaps, padding, section margins, and hero padding.

nodes.label: Shadow Depths
nodes.rationale: Four shadow levels from subtle lift to hero-image depth.

nodes.label: Button Component Specs
nodes.rationale: Primary (orange fill) and secondary (outlined) buttons with 200ms ease transitions.

nodes.label: Card Component Specs
nodes.rationale: Light background cards with shadow-md and hover lift.

nodes.label: Input Component Specs
nodes.rationale: Bordered inputs with primary-color focus ring.

nodes.label: Modal Component Specs
nodes.rationale: Blurred overlay with white rounded modal card, shadow-xl.

nodes.label: Retro-Futurism Style
nodes.rationale: Style chosen for gaming/entertainment; vintage sci-fi, 80s aesthetic, neon glow, CRT scanlines, glitch effects; best for nostalgic, cyberpunk projects.

nodes.label: Portfolio Grid Page Pattern
nodes.rationale: Visuals-first conversion strategy: hover overlay info, lightbox view, filter by category; section order Hero, Project Grid (Masonry), About/Philosophy, Contact.

nodes.label: Anti-Patterns (Forbidden)
nodes.rationale: Forbidden: minimalist design, static assets, emojis as icons, missing cursor:pointer, layout-shifting hovers, low contrast below 4.5:1, instant state changes, invisible focus states.

nodes.label: Landing Page
nodes.rationale: Page type Landing/Marketing; rules here override the Master file; documents only deviations.

nodes.label: Page Overrides Mechanism
nodes.rationale: If design-system/pages/[page-name].md exists, its rules override the Master file; otherwise the Master applies.

nodes.label: Narrative Chapter Sections
nodes.rationale: Full-width centered sections: 1. Intro hook, 2. Chapter 1 (problem), 3. Chapter 2 (journey), 4. Chapter 3 (solution), 5. Climax CTA; max width 1200px.

nodes.label: Progressive Reveal Colors
nodes.rationale: Color strategy: each chapter has a distinct color, building intensity toward the climax; also avoids full-size unoptimized images and missing navigation feedback.

nodes.label: Frame-by-Frame Sprite Effects
nodes.rationale: Recommended effects: frame-by-frame sprite animation, blinking cursor, instant transitions, marquee text; WebP images; active nav highlight; mini CTA per chapter plus final climax CTA.

nodes.label: Apolaki - God of War and the Sun
nodes.rationale: Fierce god of the sun and patron deity of warriors in Filipino mythology; boss of the Daragang Magayon volcanic region whose trial of fire blocks passage - only survivors of the molten flows may face him. Featured in the landing SiteLoader sequence as 'God of War and the Sun' and seeded into the wiki as 'Apolaki Boss'.

nodes.label: Babaylan - Spiritual Healer Role
nodes.rationale: The Babaylan is a spiritual medium, healer, and keeper of tribal lore who channels divine light (diwatas/spirits). In the game she is one of the four playable roles alongside Mandirigma, Bagani, and Mangangayaw, functioning as the mystical healer/support caster.

nodes.label: Ang Kabilang Mundo (The Other World)
nodes.rationale: The game world is 'Ang Pook ng Kabilang Mundo' - a memory-bound afterlife realm where the gods hid humanity's memories after the celestial war. Ang Lagusan (the Passage) is its entry portal, and the world is also referenced as the location 'Ang Kabilang Mundo' with Tagalog title 'Lagusan' in seed data.

nodes.label: Agos-Oras Special Item Card
nodes.rationale: Third special item card obtainable after defeating a dungeon mini-boss: grants the party 4 rounds with no skill cooldowns, a combat pacing mechanic tied to the turn-based fight scene.

nodes.label: Babaylan (Healer Class)
nodes.rationale: Spiritual medium, healer, and keeper of tribe lore; channels diwata/ancestral power for healing, curse purification, and battle blessings.

nodes.label: Bagani (Tank Class)
nodes.rationale: Protector-knight who swore a sacred oath; ironwood shield blessed by mountain deities, taunts enemies to shield companions.

nodes.label: Sacrifice Ability
nodes.rationale: Group-heal balanced by self-HP cost (lose 200 HP) - burst healing trade-off preventing free healing.

nodes.label: Last Stand Ability
nodes.rationale: Emergency defensive mechanic gated by HP<=20% requirement - rewards low-HP tank play.

nodes.label: Guardian's Oath Ability
nodes.rationale: Protection trade-off: sacrifice 25% current HP to shield all allies - team utility at personal cost.

nodes.label: Bathala (Supreme Creator God, Main Boss)
nodes.rationale: Supreme creator deity of Philippine mythology; in-game main boss ruling Kaluwalhatian, retreated to the celestial realm after the Great Fragmentation, wielding the skyhammer and guarding the Stone of Birth. His boss art is used for the wiki boss page, site loader, and landing page.

nodes.label: Bakunawa (Moon-Eating Sea Serpent, Main Boss)
nodes.rationale: Colossal sea serpent dragon that devours the moons; defeated and bound to the ocean floor by Bathala. Main boss of Dagat ng Kabisayaan; his art appears in the wiki boss page and site loader.

nodes.label: Balaraw (Special Item)
nodes.rationale: 1st special item: dagger obtained after defeating the dungeon mini boss of Dagat ng Kabisayaan; grants x2 dungeon buff +5% -> +15% DMG to all.

nodes.label: Kalasag (Special Item)
nodes.rationale: 2nd special item: shield obtained after defeating the mini boss of Daragang Magayon; grants x1 dungeon buff +15% -> +25% DEF to 2 players.

nodes.label: Dagat ng Kabisayaan (Region)
nodes.rationale: Sapphire seas dotted with floating islets, watched by ocean spirits and Maguayan; where the first balangay boats sailed. Holds the slumbering Bakunawa and the Balaraw mini boss.

nodes.label: Daragang Magayon (Region)
nodes.rationale: Land of colossal smoke-crowned volcanic peaks named after the legendary maiden; rivers of magma guarded by elemental spirits. Grants the Kalasag after its mini boss.

nodes.label: Bundok Pulag (Region)
nodes.rationale: Highest playground of the gods, shrouded in rolling white clouds; sacred mountain bridging the mortal realm and Kaluwalhatian, home to ancient pine forests, mountain spirits, and ancestral graves.

nodes.label: Mandirigma (The Unstoppable Warrior)
nodes.rationale: Playable Pinili role: Damage / Melee DPS frontline warrior armed with a heavy kampilan sword, 'shield and sword of the Balangay'. Blessed by Apolaki with raw strength. Presets: Glass Canon, Bruiser, Berserker. Skills: Attack, Heavy Attack, Rest, All-in Attack, Berserk State. Card kit includes role card, preset cards, and skill cards.

nodes.label: Mangangayaw (The Phantom Hunter)
nodes.rationale: Playable Pinili role: Ranged DPS hunter-ranger of the sky forests armed with a longbow/composite bow, striking from afar with pinpoint accuracy, volleys, explosive arrows, and traps. Presets: Sniper, Ranger, Hunter. Skills: Quick Shot, Piercing Arrow, Volley, Focus Aim, Explosive Arrow.

nodes.label: Mayari (Diyosa ng Buwan)
nodes.rationale: Main boss and goddess of the moon, co-ruler of the heavens, single-eyed grace; fought Apolaki to establish equality of night and day. Rules the night with a silver spear (lore) / silver sword 'Tears of the Moon' (timeline); guards the relic Tabak ng Luha ng Buwan at the Pilak na Baybayin with her Manananggal servants. Part of the deity trinity with Bathala and Apolaki.

nodes.label: Memory Fragment (Relic Fragment)
nodes.rationale: Game relic fragment of type 'Fragment': 'The combination of all sacred relics. A fragment of the ultimate truth.' Pieces of memory that must be kept separate, because if reassembled they could bring calamity to the world; deliberately NOT a standalone relic but the combination of all relics (see .planning/debug/balangay-fix-loop.md).

nodes.label: Minokawa (Sky-Devouring Beast)
nodes.rationale: Boss creature, 'Lawin ng Kamatayan' (Eagle of Death): a giant dragon-like bird of myth so massive it swallows the sun; feathers of steel, eyes like mirrors, nests in the outer void; hunts during eclipses; appeased by collective songs of floating tribes; Bakunawa's 'Eat the Sun and Moon' passive summons Minokawa at 50% HP. Visual appearance read from code context/alt text, not direct vision.

nodes.label: Sirena (Sovereign of the Deep)
nodes.rationale: Guardian creature 'Ang Bantay ni Bakunawa at Minokawa': beautiful water spirit with the lower body of a fish residing in Dagat ng Kabisayaan; haunting melodic songs enchant sailors and pull them into the depths; guardian of the ocean's relics who tests hearts of mortals. Visual appearance read from code context/alt text, not direct vision.

nodes.label: Tiyanak Swarm
nodes.rationale: Guardian creature 'Ang Bantay ni Apolaki' in Daragang Magayon: malevolent forest spirit disguised as a crying newborn that lures travelers, then transforms into a clawed demon with sharp fangs draining lifeforce; depicted as a swarm. Visual appearance read from code context/alt text, not direct vision.

nodes.label: The Age of the Balangay (Timeline Event)
nodes.rationale: Year 500, era 'Age of the Balangay': unity established among the floating tribes; the Balangay of the Forgotten was commissioned as a vessel of lore and protection.
